name: Lasso a Brainrot
desc:
🎯 Buy a Lasso! 🤠
Grab your lasso and get ready for action!

🧠 Catch the Brainrots!
Catch the Brainrots using your lasso before it's too late

👥 Play With Your Friends!
Team up together and rescue as many Brainrots as you can!

💥 Unlock New Lassos & Get Stronger!
Collect better lassos

🧠 Other players can steal the Brainrots you catch with your Lasso! ⚠️
Stay alert, defeat your rivals, and make sure you secure the Brainrots first! 💥
